Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor documentation request: DPA, SOC 2 report, subprocessor list + PO routing

Hi Ava,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. TideSync’s procurement team is ready to move forward with vendor onboarding for the proof-of-concept. Before we can route a PO, we need the following documentation from Redwood: 

- Executable Data Processing Addendum (DPA) or a link to signable DPA
- SOC 2 Type II report (or a secure link where we can download the report)
- Current subprocessor list (CSV or spreadsheet preferred)
- Instructions for PO submission and billing contact (AP email, invoice remit address, required PO fields)

Attached is our vendor questionnaire (TideSync_vendor_questionnaire.pdf) — please confirm which fields we must complete and what you expect back from us. Our target is to issue a PO by end of week, so if we can get these items in the next 48–72 hours that would be ideal.

Quick logistics: our billing contact is listed on the questionnaire (Procurement Billing Team, ap@tidesync.com). We generally send a PDF PO (PurchaseOrder_TideSync_1234.pdf) to vendor AP. Let me know if Redwood requires a vendor form or specific invoicing language.

Thanks in advance — copying procurement@tidesync.com.

Best,
Anna Li
Procurement Manager
TideSync

(415) 555-0198

Attachment: TideSync_vend_questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Vendor documentation request: DPA, SOC 2 report, subprocessor list + PO routing

Hi Anna — thanks for the note and the questionnaire. Happy to get this moving. Below are the items and next steps from our side: 

1) DPA: link to our standard DPA (PDF) — https://redwood-inference.app/docs/dpa. We can provide a signable DocuSign copy if TideSync needs an executed DPA; please indicate the legal signatory’s name and email.

2) SOC 2: we host the latest SOC 2 Type II report behind a secure download link. I’ve added the report link below (access tokened). If TideSync prefers an in-person review or NDA-first access, we can arrange that.

3) Subprocessor list: attached as subprocessor_list.csv (current as of 2026-11-01). It includes data center providers, analytics vendors, and third-party monitoring. If you need supplier SOC links for any subprocessor, note which ones and we’ll pull that.

4) PO / billing: Our preferred AP route is ap@redwood-inference.com. Required PO fields: Redwood vendor code RW-00981, billing remit address: Redwood Inference, Attn: Accounts Payable, 1450 Market St, Suite 600, San Francisco, CA 94103. Net terms are usually Net30 unless pre-agreed. Please send a PDF PO and include your internal PO number in the email subject.

What I’m attaching now: redwood_dpa.pdf (standard DPA), soc2-summary.pdf (summary with link to full report), subprocessor_list.csv, vendor-setup-form.pdf (please complete this and return — helps Finance speed onboarding).

If you like, Ben can help with purchase order routing and Marcus can confirm any procurement controls on our side. 

Next steps for TideSync:
- Complete vendor-setup-form.pdf and return to ap@redwood-inference.com
- Send PDF PO with TideSync PO number to ap@redwood-inference.com
- Indicate desired payment terms (Net30/Net45) and legal signatory for the DPA if you want it executed

Happy to hop on a 15-min call if any of the fields on the questionnaire are unclear.

Thanks,

Ava Chen
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com
(628) 555-0172

Attachments: redwood_dpa.pdf (PDF, stub), soc2-summary.pdf (PDF, stub), subprocessor_list.csv (CSV, stub), vendor-setup-form.pdf (PDF, stub)
